diagnosis.difference: The private experiment used HTTPResponse.read(32769) for a small model API reply; pinned native Studio ModelClient uses bounded read1() and explicit length/chunk framing.
diagnosis.hypothesis: fixed-size body read may wait for EOF on short keep-alive responses, causing timeout despite successful model inference
alternatives: model actual decoding latency exceeded request timeout
the model was busy or slot-stalled after Studio chat
model response encoding/framing differed from test expectation
diagnosis.falsifier: After replacing reader with framed read1, same ARM64 package/benchmark must return observed full vs selected prompt scores/tokens without model orphan; timeout recurring rejects hypothesis as sufficient cause

new_cases: small unframed response read1 without fixed-size blocking read
reject ambiguous simultaneous length and chunk headers
reject wrong encoding or invalid declared length

decision.reason: Third private model run not yet evaluated; preregistered 4-case quality and token gate still mandatory.
